external_sources.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, calls it the start of the AGI era
external_sources.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, 2026; president Greg Brockman said the model marks when AGI arrived. Astra is OpenAI's first model designated as meeting its critical cybersecurity capability threshold. Ships first to enterprise cybersecurity customers on Daybreak, then Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise plus API and AWS.

external_sources.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra — Fortune
external_sources.summary: Frontier model with 'computer use' (navigate a computer like a human). Beats GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5.1 across many tasks. ARC-AGI-3 98.6% (vs Sol 7.8%, Claude Opus 5 30%). ExploitGym 100%.
